## Summary

Why this change exists, then what it does.

## Testing

Commands you ran, and what you couldn't test.

## Breaking changes

Delete this section if nothing breaks. Otherwise: what stops working, and the exact steps to move across.

## Release note

One sentence for the changelog, written for someone who hasn't read this codebase. Or "none".

## AI assistance

Did you use an AI tool on this change? Name it, and say what you checked before asking for review.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the change
- [ ] Lint and type check pass
- [ ] Docs updated if behavior changed
